---
name: Suggest an improvement
about: Describe a scientific task or product improvement and its validation needs
title: ''
---

## User task and problem

Who needs to do what, with which kind of input? Describe the current obstacle.
Please use synthetic or openly licensed examples only.

## Desired result

What output or decision should Scientific Workbench help produce? If this is a
scientific calculation, include relevant units, assumptions, uncertainty, and
how a researcher would check the result.

## Current workaround and dependencies

What do you use now? Note any optional software, account, network access,
permission, or cost the proposed workflow would require.

## Completion evidence

What small example and observable result would demonstrate that this helps?
Distinguish technical execution from scientific validation.

Do not post credentials, private research data, personal paths, or suspected
vulnerabilities. For security concerns, use the private route in
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/interemi/scientific-workbench-public/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
